pages.text: If you spend too much time near the Wither Storm, you may get infected with $(thing)Wither Sickness$(). Signaled by purple spots all over the body, this disease slowly lowers your maximum health. The only known cure is $(item)Golden Apple Stew$(), made with a drop from a fully-infected monster combined with plenty of curatives.

Once you eat the stew or give it to an infected entity, it'll take a little while to be fully cured. Make sure to stay away from the Wither Storm during this time, as it might overpower the stew's effect and worsen the infection.
